name: LLMLingua compression
description: Compresses long tool results and long system/instruction texts with LLMLingua-2 before they reach the model, through an llmlingua-api server.

url.title: API URL
url.description: Base URL of the llmlingua-api server, e.g. http://llmlingua:3030. A private address must be in OUTBOUND_ALLOWLIST.

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: Fraction of tokens to keep, in (0, 1]. Defaults to 0.5.

minChars.title: Minimum length
minChars.description: Texts shorter than this are left alone. Defaults to 2000.
